info.name: CarePoint API
info.description:
CarePoint backend API — local development collection.

Import, set the collection variables (or use the defaults), then run requests in order. Session cookies (`cp_access`, `cp_refresh`) are stored automatically by Postman's cookie jar after a successful Login / Verify email / Google sign-in.

All mutating requests must carry the header `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` (CSRF defense) — it is pre-set on each request.

EMAIL CODES: with the default `MAIL_PROVIDER=log`, OTP codes are printed to the Spring Boot console — look for `MAIL(log-provider)`. Paste the 6-digit code into the `{{otpCode}}` variable (or edit the request body). Codes are valid 2 minutes, allow 4 wrong tries, and only 4 sends are permitted before a cooldown.

request.description:
Expected: 201 + {id, email, message}. A 6-digit verification code is 'sent' — with MAIL_PROVIDER=log it appears in the backend console.
Run twice to see 409 EMAIL_TAKEN.
Expected: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with fields.password listing the unmet rules (≥8 chars, upper, lower, digit) — renderable as a UI checklist.
Expected: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with fields.confirmPassword = "Passwords do not match".

Expected: 200 + user JSON + session cookies (logged in immediately).
Copy the 6-digit code from the backend console into {{otpCode}} — valid 2 minutes, 4 wrong tries kill it.
Wrong/expired code: 400 OTP_INVALID.

Expected: 204 always (unknown emails get the same answer — no enumeration).
After 4 total sends, further sends within the cooldown window return 429 RATE_LIMITED.
Expected: 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED until Verify email succeeds — run it right after Register.

Expected: 204 always — the response never reveals whether the email exists.
If the account exists, a PASSWORD_RESET code is mailed (backend console under MAIL_PROVIDER=log).

Expected: 204. Paste the reset code into {{otpCode}} first.
Side effects: all existing sessions are revoked — log in again with the new password.
Wrong code: 400 OTP_INVALID. Policy/confirm failures: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

Expected: 200 + user JSON + session cookies. Creates the account on first sign-in.
Requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID configured; the idToken comes from a real Google sign-in on the frontend.
Invalid token: 401 GOOGLE_TOKEN_INVALID.

Expected: 200 + user JSON; Set-Cookie: cp_access (15 min JWT) + cp_refresh (30 d, HttpOnly).
Postman stores cookies automatically — Me / Refresh / Logout need no manual token handling.
Expected: 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS — same envelope whether the email or the password is wrong (no user enumeration).
Expected: 403 CSRF_HEADER_MISSING — mutating requests require X-Requested-With.
Expected: 200 + current user (uses cp_access cookie). Without login: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED.

Expected: 204 + rotated cp_access/cp_refresh cookies.
Rotation: the old refresh token dies — replaying it yields 401 and revokes the whole family (theft detection).
Expected: 204; clears both cookies and revokes the refresh family server-side.

Expected: 201 + {id, name, slug, timezone, message}. The verified caller becomes CLINIC_ADMIN.
Saves clinicId for the requests below. Requires a verified login first.
Expected: 200 + [{membershipId, clinicId, clinicName, role}] — every clinic where you hold staff role.

Expected: 200 + staff array (CLINIC_ADMIN/RECEPTIONIST only).
Run Create clinic first — uses {{clinicId}}.

Expected: 201 + StaffView. New emails get a set-password OTP by mail; existing users gain the membership.
Roles: DOCTOR | RECEPTIONIST | CLINIC_ADMIN. Saves membershipId for PATCH below.
Expected: 403 ACCESS_DENIED when sent with a patient-only session; 404 NOT_FOUND for staff of a different clinic.

Expected: 200 + updated StaffView. Send role and/or status (ACTIVE|DISABLED).
You cannot modify your own membership; the clinic always keeps one active admin.
Expected: 200 with status=DISABLED. Disabled members lose access on their next request.

Expected: 200 + Page {content, totalElements, ...}. No auth needed.
?name= filters by name prefix. Saves first clinic as {{clinicId}}.
Expected: 200 + clinic object; 404 NOT_FOUND for unknown/disabled.
Expected: 200 + [{id, name}] — the global catalog. Saves first id as {{specialtyId}}.

Expected: 200 + Page of {id, fullName, specialty, consultMinutes}.
Filters: specialtyId + q (name prefix). Saves {{doctorId}}.
Expected: 200 + {id, fullName, specialty, bio, consultMinutes}; 404 cross-clinic.
Expected: 200 + only the specialties this clinic's doctors offer.

Expected: 201 + profile. CLINIC_ADMIN only; membership must be DOCTOR or CLINIC_ADMIN role.
Run 'Invite staff' first so {{membershipId}} is set.
Expected: 200 + updated profile. CLINIC_ADMIN only.

Expected: 200 + [{start, end}] UTC slots — schedule minus time-off minus booked.
from/to: ISO dates, max 31 days, not past. Rate-limited 60/min/IP.

Expected: 200 + saved windows. Replaces the whole weekly template.
Who: CLINIC_ADMIN, RECEPTIONIST, or the doctor for their own profile.
dayOfWeek: 0=Mon … 6=Sun. slotMinutes: 10/15/20/30/45/60. No same-day overlaps.
Expected: 200 + weekly windows. Requires clinic staff membership.
Expected: 201 + created block. Saves {{timeOffId}}. UTC instants.
Expected: 200 + dated exception blocks.
Expected: 204. Run 'Add time off' first.

Books {{slotStart}}-{{slotEnd}} UTC for {{doctorId}}.
Requires: clinicId + doctorId set (Clinics & staff + Discovery folders), and a doctor schedule covering next Monday 09:00-09:30 UTC (run 'Set doctor schedule' first).
Expected: 201 + appointment; Idempotency-Key UUID is auto-generated once and reused by the replay request.

Same Idempotency-Key + identical payload returns the original booking, no duplicate.
Expected: 201 with the same id.

Same key + different payload → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
Run 'Book appointment' first so the key is stored.

09:15-09:45 is not a schedule-grid slot → 409 INVALID_SLOT.
Adjust times if your schedule uses different slotMinutes.
Patient's own future BOOKED appointments across clinics. when=upcoming|past.
Cancelled/completed/past appointments for the signed-in patient.
Owner-only: another patient's appointment id returns 404, never 403.
Cancels the caller's own appointment. 409 CANCELLATION_WINDOW_PASSED inside the clinic cutoff (default 24h before start).
Re-cancelling returns current state rather than an error.

RECEPTIONIST or CLINIC_ADMIN only. Defaults to today when from/to are omitted; optional doctorId + status filters.
Sign in as the invited receptionist (see Clinics & staff → Invite staff) before running.

Books for a patient without an account — a claimable GUEST record is created (they register with the same email to claim it).
Use patientId instead of patient{} to book for an existing user. Needs a schedule covering {{slotStart}} (run 'Set doctor schedule').
Atomic cancel + rebook: the old slot frees and the new one books in one transaction. Optional doctorId moves it to another doctor.
BOOKED → CANCELLED|COMPLETED|NO_SHOW. Staff bypass the patient cancellation cutoff; COMPLETED/NO_SHOW require the slot to have started.

The signed-in doctor's own appointments for ?date= (defaults to today).
Requires a session for the user who owns {{doctorId}}'s membership — sign in as the invited doctor.
